prompt: A triangular sail has two corner angles measuring $40^\circ$ and $75^\circ$. What is the measure of the third angle, in degrees?
hint: The three angles of any triangle add to the same total.

hints.text: The three angles of any triangle add to the same total.

explanation: The Triangle Sum Theorem says the three interior angles add to $180^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Tear the corners off
steps: Cut a paper triangle and tear off all three corners.
Slide them together point to point and they form a perfectly straight line — $180^\circ$, every time.
